description: Read one roll of images, video and sound, newest first: each generation with its status, file urls and prompt (long ones end in …, a repeat reads "Same prompt as above."), and the roll's own @elements; list_elements has the space's. Pass query to find "the one where…" by words in its prompt, cursor to read on, or generation_ids for those generations with full prompts. Roll ids come from list_space or a storyboard. A file marked favorite is one your human hearted in the app, their pick from the roll; favorites=true lists only generations with one.

favorites.description: Only generations with a file your human hearted.

generation_ids.description: Only these generations, with full prompts.

query.description: Words to find in prompts; any word matches, most words first.

name: read_roll
title: Read roll
